Following features are added.
  • Fixed a freeze bug that occurs when a certain voice file for a Rifle Demon with The Youngster personality is played.
  • Fixed text in the game the appeared as "H"s.
  • Removed Gun from character Rutile's weapon forte.
  • Fixed Time Leap Episode 3 title screen text when language is set to English.
  • Fixed Time Leap Episode 3 text not showing up on screen when language is set to English.
